description: Checks that a purchase order, goods receipt and invoice agree on supplier, currency, amount, line items, unit prices and quantities received. Stateless; you attach the documents. Checks caller-supplied documents, not independently verified ERP records. Returns PASSED or FAILED and a reason code; no CRO/VIES lookup, signature validation or bank transfer is performed by this tool. Use decide_supplier_payment when document matching must be combined with supplier identity, VAT, payee and signature checks. Requires an explicitly approved service fee.

quantity.description: Positive ordered or invoiced quantity; send an exact decimal string.
quantity.title: Quantity

sku.description: Item identifier used consistently across invoice, PO and receipt.
sku.title: Sku

unit_price.description: Nonnegative unit price in the document currency; send an exact decimal string.
unit_price.title: Unit Price

goods_receipt.description: Goods receipt linked to the same PO; supply received SKU quantities and supplier CRO number.

invoice.description: Invoice document fields, including reference numbers, currency, amount, payee name and line items.

purchase_order.description: Purchase order to compare with the invoice; supply the expected supplier, currency, amount and ordered items.

supplier_cro_number.description: Expected supplier CRO number to match against the supplied PO and goods receipt; not looked up in CRO by this tool.
supplier_cro_number.title: Supplier Cro Number

request.description: 3-way match PO, goods receipt and invoice: supply this structured object using the nested schema, not a JSON-encoded string.

name: check_three_way_match
